implementation_notes: interface declares a contract that is erased at compile time, so the contract module can be imported with import type by clients that never load any implementation - the deployment separation is the default state rather than something to engineer. Ambient declaration files (.d.ts) go further and describe an implementation shipped elsewhere (native add-on, CDN script, injected global) with no implementation code in the project at all. Keep a runtime abstract class only when instanceof or shared implementation is needed.
pitfalls: Interfaces are erased, so runtime checks (instanceof, a DI token) need a class, a unique symbol or a discriminated field instead.
Structural typing accepts accidental matches: any object with a compatible shape satisfies the interface without intent.
import type erases the import, so mistakenly using a value from a type-only import fails only when the type checker runs.
